# cubepath_ssh_key (Data Source)

Fetches an existing SSH key by name



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SSH key name to lookup

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SSH key fingerprint
- `id` (String) SSH key ID
- `key_type` (String) SSH key type (e.g., ssh-rsa, ssh-ed25519)
